findings.en: Show or set reasoning effort (shift+tab cycles)
findings.target: Muestra o fija el esfuerzo de razonamiento
findings.problem: This round's fix for ES-m3 restored 'de razonamiento' and deleted the '(shift+tab alterna)' clause, so the picker row no longer teaches the shortcut. All three elements cannot fit (verb + concept + token is 62 cells), but a form that keeps the concept, the token and a verb does fit: it pays with 'Show or', the half a user can guess from the command name. The deleted token is the half they cannot guess: 'shift+tab' now appears in no es catalogue at all (grep, zero hits), and its only other teacher is the /keys legend, hardcoded English in tui/app.py:56049.
findings.suggested: Fija el esfuerzo de razonamiento; shift+tab alterna
findings.note: No <=51-cell string carries verb + 'de razonamiento' + token; the choice of what to drop is open. Second-best, if the 'Show or' half must stay: 'Muestra o fija el esfuerzo; shift+tab alterna' (45) keeps verb + token and drops 'de razonamiento', i.e. re-opens ES-m3. Recorded as MINOR rather than a hard defect because every surviving form loses something en states.

findings.en: List agents, switch an agent's class, or speak to this session as one
findings.target: Lista agentes, cambia su clase o habla a la sesión
findings.problem: The fix for round-1 ES-m1 restored an addressee and removed the manner reading, but deleted 'as one': the third clause now says only 'speak to the session', which every slash command does, and no longer says the session is addressed AS AN AGENT — the payload of /agent (the user-driven way to adopt a role/specialist mid-session, per the registry comment in slash_commands.py). Of the two claims in that clause the fix kept the weaker one.
findings.suggested: Lista agentes, cambia su clase o habla como uno
findings.note: Keeps 'as one' and fits with 3 cells to spare; drops 'to this session', which the row's own context supplies. '…o adopta uno' (43) states the mechanism more plainly if a verb change is acceptable; '…o habla a la sesión como agente' is 62 and cannot fit.

findings.en: Branch this chat; --switch here, --window elsewhere; <message> starts work
findings.problem: Round-1 ES-m2 is fixed (<message> is back) and the price is the second flag: '--window' is no longer named in the picker. This is an honest width trade, not a gratuitous drop — all three claims are 65 cells against a 51-cell column. '<message> inicia' is also clipped: the object ('el trabajo') would cost 13 more cells.
findings.note: Recorded, not demanded, so the owner can decide which flag survives the budget.

findings.en: Open Hub links — per-link subscribe and auto-push policy
findings.target: Abre enlaces del hub: suscripción y push por enlace
findings.problem: Round-1 ES-m5 is fixed (verb and per-link both restored). The trade is 'auto-push' -> 'push': the automaticity and the word 'policy' are gone. The alternative is the same width, not shorter ('Abre enlaces del hub: suscripción y push automático' = 51), so this is a coin-flip the implementer called in favour of granularity.
findings.note: Lower-case 'hub' is not a finding: es already says 'el hub' as a common noun in wire.settings.hub.description, while the proper name 'Agent Hub' stays capitalised.

findings.problem: Round-1 ES-n5 is fixed (the target is back and --stop even survived). 'Itera al objetivo' is the one calque left: 'iterar' takes 'hacia', and 'al objetivo' reads as a literal 'to the goal'.
findings.note: The idiomatic form does not fit beside --stop ('Itera hacia el objetivo: /loop <goal>, <n>; --stop corta' = 56); the flag is the better thing to keep, so this is a preference, not a defect.
